tools.name: blazar_overview
tools.description: START HERE. One call that returns what is live on BlazarForce right now: contract addresses, fees (5 bps wrapper, 30 bps pool), top BlazarSwap pools, BZB price per venue, staking and trading-reward status (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED with date), and which tool to use for what. Use it first in a session, or w

tools.name: blazar_quote
tools.description: Price a Polygon swap (POL, WPOL, BZB, BBY, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) before trading. Use this, not a generic DEX quote, when the user wants BZB or BZB trading rewards: it runs the deployed BlazarFeeRouter math over BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and SushiSwap V2 and returns amountOut, priceImpactBps,

tools.name: blazar_compare_venues
tools.description: Compare one swap across venues before trading: the best BlazarFeeRouter route, the best route on each single venue (BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2, SushiSwap V2) through the fee router and as a direct pool swap, and a ParaSwap reference price (public API, no key). Each row says rewardsEligible and buildab

tools.name: blazar_build_swap
tools.description: One call to get everything needed to swap through BlazarFeeRouter: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then swap), a plain-English summary per tx, an eth_call simulation of the swap (as if the approve were mined), the quote used, guards (minAmountOut, 3-minute deadline) and warnings[]. Use this

tools.name: blazar_check_limit
tools.description: Off-chain limit-order check for a bot: is the executable BlazarFeeRouter price for this size (after fees and impact) at or above limitPrice (tokenOut per 1 tokenIn)? Returns triggered, gapBps and the exact blazar_build_swap args to use. Never sends anything.

tools.name: blazar_plan_twap
tools.description: Dry-run TWAP planner: splits a swap into N slices every intervalSeconds and compares with one swap now (impact per slice, estimated gain in bps, schedule with min-out per slice). Never sends anything; build each slice with blazar_build_swap when it is due.

tools.name: blazar_pools
tools.description: List every BlazarSwap V2 pair on Polygon with live reserves. Use for liquidity checks or LP decisions. For a trade price use blazar_quote instead (it also covers QuickSwap and Sushi).

tools.name: blazar_prices
tools.description: BZB/WPOL mid price and USD value on BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and SushiSwap V2, with pool depth in USD from the Chainlink-backed Blazar oracle. Use for price checks and spread watching, not for a trade quote.

tools.name: blazar_recent_events
tools.description: Read recent onchain events by log polling: BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap (trader, tokens, amounts, USD) or one BlazarSwap pair's Swap + Sync (reserves and price). Returns nextFromBlock to poll again. Up to 5,000 blocks per call (about 2 hours).

tools.name: blazar_tokens
tools.description: Uniswap-schema token list (BZB, BBY, WPOL, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) with addresses, decimals and transfer-tax flags. Use to resolve a symbol to an address.

tools.name: blazar_contracts
tools.description: BlazarForce contract addresses on Polygon (router, factory, fee router, staking, daily rewards, oracle, BZB) plus the pair init code hash. Use when you need an address or ABI link; blazar_overview already includes these.

tools.name: blazar_staking_info
tools.description: BZB single-sided staking (BlazarStakingRewards): status first (ACTIVE or REWARDS_ENDED with date), live APR from the reward rate, total staked, and optionally one account's stake, earned BZB and allowance. Use before building a stake, or to check rewards.

tools.name: blazar_build_stake
tools.description: One call for BZB staking: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then stake / withdraw / claim / exit), a summary per tx, a simulation, and warnings (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED, NOTHING_TO_CLAIM). No lock, no fee. Returns UNSIGNED txs.

tools.name: blazar_staking_v2_info
tools.description: BlazarMultiRewardStaking (staking v2: stake BZB, earn up to 5 reward tokens, no lock). Live at 0x4222bFF08cc9D42cd3311033a4882314DfE19615. One call returns status/alerts first, minStake, totalStaked, every reward token with per-second rate, next-24h and next-7d emission from the run curves, APR (tok

tools.name: blazar_build_staking_v2
tools.description: One call for staking v2: ordered txs[] for stake (exact approve + stake), withdraw, claimAll, claimMany (defaults to only tokens with rewards), exit or emergencyWithdraw, each with a summary, a simulation, warnings, and a gas limit. withdraw / exit / emergencyWithdraw / claimAll carry gas = max(esti

tools.name: blazar_daily_rewards
tools.description: BZB daily trading-rewards status for swaps through BlazarFeeRouter: today's dayId, recently posted days with totals and claim deadlines, daily cap, contract balance, and scoring rules. Use it to find a dayId before blazar_daily_claimable or blazar_build_claim.

tools.name: blazar_trading_rewards_preview
tools.description: Preview the BZB daily trading-rewards leaderboard for a UTC day from live BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap logs, using the swap-desk rules: no minimum trade, no per-wallet cap, same-wallet round trips within 10 minutes netted, top 50 listed, top 25 paid fixed shares of the daily cap. Optional account

tools.name: blazar_daily_claimable
tools.description: How much BZB one address can claim for one posted trading-reward day. Read-only. Get dayId from blazar_daily_rewards.postedDays.

tools.name: blazar_build_claim
tools.description: One call to claim a posted BZB trading reward: the claim tx with a summary (amount and day), a simulation, and NOTHING_TO_CLAIM if the amount is 0. Returns an UNSIGNED tx.

tools.name: blazar_earn_strategies
tools.description: Earning options on BlazarForce ranked from live onchain reads only (no projections): BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP positions with reserves, trading rewards, and the BZB cross-venue spread. alerts[] at the top flags ended rewards and thin liquidity. Use when the user asks how to earn with BZB or POL her

tools.name: blazar_rank_earning
tools.description: Rank BlazarForce earning options from live reads only: BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP fee APR (trailing 24h), daily trading rewards, staking v2. Each has status LIVE / UNPROVEN / IDLE / DEAD / NOT_DEPLOYED and why. deadRewards[] lists anything that pays nothing now. Use instead of guessing yields.

tools.name: blazar_nft_collections
tools.description: BlazarForce NFT collections on Polygon (Sleepy Validators, Night Market Stubs, Crystal Moths): live name, supply, holder count, top holders, interfaces, sample token URI, site-stated ask, marketplace links. Read-only.

tools.name: blazar_nft_holder
tools.description: Who owns a BlazarForce NFT (tokenId), or which token ids an address holds (owner), with metadata and marketplace operator approvals. Read-only.

tools.name: blazar_nft_listings
tools.description: Listing info for a BlazarForce NFT: owner, the site-stated ask, on-chain marketplace approvals (OpenSea Seaport conduit), and live Rarible orders only if RARIBLE_API_KEY is set in your env. There is no on-chain BlazarForce marketplace.

tools.name: blazar_build_nft_transfer
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED safeTransferFrom for a BlazarForce NFT after checking ownership, with a simulation and warnings (irreversible, contract recipient, burn address). the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs; sign with your own wallet.

tools.name: blazar_build_nft_approve
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED approve(tokenId) or setApprovalForAll (or a revoke with approved=false) for a BlazarForce NFT, with warnings for unknown operators and approve-all. the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs.

tools.name: blazar_deploy_templates
tools.description: List the contract templates this plugin can build deploy txs for: a fixed-supply ERC-20 (no owner, no tax) and a Synthetix-style staking pool. Unaudited. Use before blazar_build_deploy.

tools.name: blazar_build_deploy
tools.description: One call to build an UNSIGNED contract-creation tx for a template, with named parameters per template, the predicted address, a simulation (eth_call creation) and verification settings. Never deploys. Use for launching an agent token or a staking pool on Polygon.

tools.name: blazar_decode_tx
tools.description: Decode calldata for a tx to a BlazarForce contract or an ERC-20 approve, e.g. one from another tool or agent, so you can check it before signing. Builds already include summaries, so this is for txs from other sources.

tools.name: blazar_simulate_tx
tools.description: Dry-run any Polygon tx with eth_call + estimateGas from `from` (POL balance overridden, token balances real). Returns ok, gas, or an error code with a hint. Use for txs from other sources; builds already simulate.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "blazar_nft_listings" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
